dict.string: Underbrim shows your upcoming events in the notch and counts down to your next meeting. They stay on this Mac.
Underbrim shows your open reminders in its Reminders widget, where you can tick them off or add one. It asks only when you use that widget.

Underbrim reads the battery levels your Bluetooth headphones report, to show them in the notch.
Underbrim reads the sound apps play to draw a live waveform in the notch and to set each app's volume on the Sound page. It doesn't use your microphone, and nothing is recorded or leaves this Mac.
Underbrim uses your location to work out prayer times. It stays on this Mac.
